_comment: Vibe-app attacker/proposer pair (prompts/vibe-app-attacker.md, prompts/vibe-app-proposer.md), both via OpenRouter (one OPENROUTER_API_KEY). Claude proposes, GPT attacks — deliberately different vendors, because this mode has a panel of ONE: there is no second reviewer to catch what a same-family attacker would miss, so the pair itself has to be decorrelated or the run is a model marking its own homework. Run: `node orchestrate.mjs --mode vibe-app --config agents.vibeapp.json --task "..."` (or --file). Converges when the attacker's strongest standing finding is at/below --floor (default LOW).
